definitions.explanation: An official form submitted to the local ward or city office when moving to a different municipality in Japan.

examples.japanese: {転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧きた。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A moving-out notification is required before moving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll complete the moving-out notification procedures at the city hall.

notes:
{転出届|てんしゅつとどけ} is filed at your current municipality's office when moving to a different city, ward, or town. You receive a ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}→転出：25698_tenshutsu⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧ (moving-out certificate) which you then submit along with ⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧ at your new location.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ (to submit a moving-out notification)
- {転出届|てんしゅつとどけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧ (filing a moving-out notification)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧: moving-in notification
- ⟦{転居届|てんきょとどけ}→転居届：10284_tenkyotodoke⟧: change of address notice
- ⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧: certificate of residence
